title: Reviews stall for hours because reviewer wakes fail on a busy corner checkout or repeat on unchanged code
whatHappens: A corner's PR gets no commits for 3-6 hours while reviewer wakes fail with checkout in use or ask again for a verdict on an unchanged head.

fixes.text: Reviewer gets its own checkout copy and orders wait their turn (morning card item 1, bundled with corner-checkout-busy); needs owner yes

observations.text: Velocity 30-31 Oct: 3 PRs (#3115, #3118, #3119) had 3-6 h commit gaps 16:39-21:59 UTC, about 15 PR-hours (7% of 214). 10 feedback reports in that window: checkout in use and same-head re-review.
